text_block_list.text:
After joining the team, Narita Brian's
performance doesn't just
stabilize—it gets
better and better.

With the Satsuki Sho won, next will be the
most celebrated race in
the Twinkle Series,
the Tokyo Yushun—the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
After your last race, some are predicting
you'll be a Triple Crown
champion! Are
you confident you can become the fifth
ever to do it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even gotten the second crown in
the Japanese Derby yet.
Why bother
jumping the gun?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Racers who didn't participate in the
Satsuki Sho will be running in the
Japanese
Derby. What's your strategy against these
new rivals?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Strategy? Hmph... All I need to do is get
to the finish line first.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Brian, please, over here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Me first, hey Brian!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just look at the number of journalists.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got their eyes on her right
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's in the middle of a five-win streak,
with two of them being G1
races. That
momentum has taken her straight to the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When the big day comes, I have no doubt
she'll be the favorite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, high expectations mean one
misstep could do immense
damage... like
what happened to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How will she face the pressure of being
the favorite in such an
important race? It'll
be the moment of truth for her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Let me do one more sprint on the ramped
track!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Good idea—go for it!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is 2,400 meters.
We've gotta get the ideal pace
into your
muscle memory!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: All right, understood!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The mood on the training course has been
so tense lately...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well it's the Derby! Everybody's
desperate for this
once-in-a-lifetime
chance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. Heaps of peeps have been
watching Brian train!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: They're all devising ways to beat her.

Her rivals are persistent, and they've all
marked Brian as their target.
Winning the
Derby's not going to be easy.

Which makes a certain something all the
more important...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, aren't you gonna get the big
announcement soon?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll go check. Everyone keep
training.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll go check. Everyone keep
training.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's this about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They say only the luckiest racer wins the
Derby, right? Well, we're
about to find out
whether Brian's got the luck.

Brian's good at keeping up with the lead
pack in a race. So it'll be
important to get
into a good position while conserving her
stamina as much as possible.

And the key to that is having the right
starting gate.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: No way...

Post eight-seventeen... The farthest from
the inside rail, with the most
ground to
cover. Luck isn't on Brian's side.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of the Tokyo
Yushun—the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will the standout favorite Narita Brian
take the win? Or will it be one
of her many
rivals who've pushed so far to make it
here?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You're in perfect shape!
Believe in yourself
and run with all you've
got!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Okay! When I'm out there, I'll remember
all the training I did!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
A good start is key! Take all the
advantages that inside post has to
offer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for training me! I'll
definitely bring back first place
for you!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The stands might be roaring with
excitement, but the air back here is
tense,
huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The stands might be roaring with
excitement, but the air back here is
tense,
huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You know the Derby's special. Every
racer's trained their heart out to
have a
shot at glory here.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You know the Derby's special. Every
racer's trained their heart out to
have a
shot at glory here.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And they've been prepped to go up
against you specifically. Plus,
you're in the
worst starting gate.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And they've been prepped to go up
against you specifically. Plus,
you're in the
worst starting gate.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, winning this is going to be a
challenge, so...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, winning this is going to be a
challenge, so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So what?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't need to worry about any of that.
All I need to do is rip through
the pack
and win.

Ready or not, the Derby gates open, and
I'm reminded once again...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're at the last corner, and Narita
Brian's sweeping in from far
outside! Just
like that, she's taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She blasts ahead—that's it! Brian wins it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has her second crown! With an
unbelievable five-length
lead, the Satsuki
Sho winner has claimed another amazing
victory!
Wooooo!

No matter the opponent, no matter their
strategy, no matter the odds,
she still wins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, rockstar! You tore up the
competition!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! That was better than anyone could have hoped for! Another Derby legend is born TODAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't care about other people's
expectations. Like I said before...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Derby, the Triple Crown... They're all
just stepping stones.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey, didn't she just run 2,400 meters?
Does she breathe like the
rest of us?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, you've gotta be kidding me...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, you've gotta be kidding me...

I'm her trainer, but even I have no idea
what she's really capable of. I
can barely
hide how excited that makes me.
